description: Feature flag evaluation cases shaped for the shared cross-SDK corpus (AUTH-7098). Each case is one v2 flag entry; build the payload {version: 2, flags: {<key>: flag}}, where key defaults to the flag's slug, and evaluate by that key. context maps a target type to an exact ID. An evaluation may carry a name describing what it checks. expect is true, false, or "absent": the flag has no boolean answer, so the caller's default applies. A runner must evaluate every case with both caller defaults and fail on unknown case fields. malformed marks cases that deliberately leave the v2 schema.

cases.name: rules are evaluated in payload order and the first match wins

evaluations.name: an earlier matching false rule wins and stops evaluation

no match serves the flag default, not the caller default
